description: Turn on HMAC signature verification for a bucket using the provider's own signing secret (e.g. Stripe's whsec_). This is how you finish a "verified webhook" integration end to end. Set secret to the provider secret and hmac_enabled:true in the same call; the signature scheme is auto-detected from the header shape.

header_name.description: Signature header to read (auto-detected if omitted).

on_failure.description: What to do with a failed signature.

tolerance_seconds.description: Max timestamp skew allowed, in seconds.

name: configure_verification
